blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro via the 6-day Marangu Route with huts
blocks.html: Kilimanjaro in 6 days on the Marangu Route, sleeping in huts

blocks.orig: The Marangu route might be one of the cheapest and quickest routes to the summit, but it still has plenty of wow moments in store for you. You still get to dive into the mountain’s nature on different trails and enjoy the view from the top.
blocks.html: It may be among the quickest and cheapest ways to the summit, yet the Marangu route still holds lots of memorable moments for you. You get to explore the mountain’s nature along varied trails and take in the view from the top.

blocks.orig: The downside: it can be quite busy, especially during peak season, you have less time to get used to the altitude, and you take the same route for your descent which is why you get to see less of the spectacular scenery.
blocks.html: The drawbacks: it can get fairly crowded, above all in peak season, there is less time for your body to adjust to the altitude, and because you come down along the same path, you see less of the stunning scenery.

blocks.orig: However, if you’re not too much into camping, you’ll be happy to hear that this route offers hut accommodation. And one last fun fact: it’s also called the “Coca-Cola” route… just in case you want to impress your fellow hikers and guides 😉
blocks.html: On the other hand, if camping is not really your thing, you’ll be glad to know that you sleep in huts on this route. One final fun fact: people also call it the “Coca-Cola” route… in case you would like to impress your guides and fellow hikers.

blocks.orig: Your Tanzania Trip offers a unique service throughout the climb
blocks.html: A unique service from Your Tanzania Trip for the whole climb

blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the ultimate challenge! Little details can make a world of difference, which is why with us, you climb with professional guides, porters, and a cook. They take care of you during your ascent via the Marangu route, by checking your health twice a day and serving you delicious food. Sounds like a bit much? Not if you want to reach the top! Because we know that altitude sickness can creep up on you unnoticed and that proper nutrition* is essential to keep you going during a strenuous climb.
blocks.html: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the greatest challenge of all! Small details can make a big difference, so when you climb with us, you have professional guides, porters and a cook. On your way up the Marangu route they look after you, checking your health twice a day and preparing tasty meals. Does that seem a lot? Not if reaching the top is your goal! We know that altitude sickness can sneak up on you without warning, and that good nutrition* is vital to keep you going on such a demanding climb.

blocks.orig: *If you would like to see the menu, we can send it in advance.
blocks.html: *We are happy to send you the menu beforehand if you would like to see it.

blocks.orig: If you like advice on how to prepare yourself for climbing Kilimanjaro, you can always contact us or read our blog How to prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?
blocks.html: Would you like tips on getting ready for a Kilimanjaro climb? Feel free to contact us, or read our blog How to prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you on arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He takes you to your hotel, where you can rest after the flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb begins you meet your guide, who gives you a briefing and advice on clothing, packing and other useful tips to make the climb as comfortable as possible for you.

blocks.orig: In the early morning, your guide takes you from the hotel to Marangu Gate at 1,860 m. The initial part of the trek takes you through coffee and banana plantations, as well as untouched rainforest. Take this opportunity to admire the stunning views of lush vegetation and diverse wildlife along the way. After a seven-hour hike, you reach the Mandara Huts. In the afternoon, you can choose to visit the Maundi Crater, a volcanic crater near the huts, or simply relax and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. As this is your first day at this altitude, remember to drink plenty of water!
blocks.html: Early in the morning your guide drives you from the hotel to Marangu Gate at 1,860 m. The trek begins among coffee and banana plantations and continues through untouched rainforest. Make the most of the chance to enjoy the wonderful views of green vegetation and varied wildlife on the way. A seven-hour hike brings you to the Mandara Huts. In the afternoon you can go to the Maundi Crater, a volcanic crater close to the huts, or just rest and take in the lovely setting. It is your first day at this altitude, so be sure to drink lots of water!

blocks.orig: From Mandara Huts, the landscape slowly changes. You trek through picturesque landscapes, encounter unique flora and fauna, and immerse yourself in the majestic beauty of Mount Kilimanjaro. The higher you go, the less vegetation can be seen and the more it starts to look like a lunar landscape. The air also grows thinner with altitude. Experience the thrill of ascending higher, as you make your way to the cozy and comfortable Horombo Huts for dinner and overnight.
blocks.html: After Mandara Huts the scenery gradually changes. Your trek passes through beautiful landscapes with unusual plants and animals, and you are surrounded by the impressive beauty of Mount Kilimanjaro. As you climb higher, there is less and less vegetation, and the land begins to resemble a lunar landscape. The higher you get, the thinner the air becomes. Enjoy the excitement of gaining height as you head for the cosy, comfortable Horombo Huts, where you have dinner and spend the night.

blocks.orig: Today is your additional acclimatization day. After breakfast, you go for a hike towards Kibo Huts and back. This gives your body ample time to get used to the altitude. After lunch, you have the opportunity to take some pictures of the Mawenzi Volcano, discover the area or just rest. Have a good night's sleep at the Horombo Huts again to be ready for the next day.
blocks.html: Today is an extra day to acclimatise. After breakfast you hike in the direction of Kibo Huts and then return. This gives your body plenty of time to adjust to the altitude. In the afternoon, after lunch, you can photograph the Mawenzi Volcano, explore the surroundings or simply rest. Sleep well at the Horombo Huts once more so that you are ready for tomorrow.

blocks.orig: Witness the dramatic landscape change as your hike leads through a kind of Alpine desert to a point between the two famous mountain peaks Kibo and Mawenzi. The landscape here is more open and bare and offers less shelter. The hike is challenging, but the thrill of approaching the majestic summit of Mount Kilimanjaro drives you to keep going. You arrive at Kibo Huts Camp for lunch. Don't forget to drink plenty of water and make sure you relax for the big day ahead!
blocks.html: See the landscape change dramatically as the hike takes you across a type of Alpine desert to a spot between Kibo and Mawenzi, the two famous mountain peaks. Here the terrain is more open and bare, with less shelter. It is a tough hike, but the excitement of nearing the impressive summit of Mount Kilimanjaro keeps you moving. You reach Kibo Huts Camp in time for lunch. Remember to drink lots of water and make sure you rest well before the big day!

blocks.orig: At night you start your ascent to conquer the majestic Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa! The biggest challenge lies in the first part of this climb, until you reach Gilman's Point. From here, Uhuru Peak is not far away, and relatively easy to climb. Once at the summit, enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! You descend through the Kibo Huts Camp down to the Horombo Huts, where you have dinner and overnight. You are on your feet for about twelve hours today, so prepare for a challenging but rewarding day!
blocks.html: During the night you set off to conquer the impressive Uhuru Peak, Africa's highest point! The hardest stretch is the first section of the climb, up to Gilman's Point. From there Uhuru Peak is close by and fairly easy to reach. At the summit you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is very impressive at this altitude! You then descend via the Kibo Huts Camp to the Horombo Huts for dinner and the night. Today you are on your feet for around twelve hours, so be ready for a demanding yet rewarding day!

blocks.orig: Your incredible journey comes to an end as you descend to Marangu Gate, the exit of Kilimanjaro National Park. This wonderful five to six-hour walk takes you through beautiful forests. Once at Marangu Gate, your guide drives you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest and a celebration of your remarkable achievement. Unforgettable memories, breathtaking views, and a true sense of accomplishment await and will stay with you forever!
blocks.html: Your remarkable journey ends as you walk down to Marangu Gate, where you leave Kilimanjaro National Park. This lovely walk of five to six hours leads you through beautiful forests. At Marangu Gate your guide is waiting to drive you back to the hotel, where you can enjoy a well-earned rest and celebrate what you have achieved. Unforgettable memories, stunning views and a real feeling of accomplishment lie ahead, and they will stay with you forever!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday is over and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight back. Would you like more? You can also combine your Kilimanjaro adventure with a few extra days of safari or a beach holiday!
